entries.title: Ask HN: Who is hiring? (May 2013)
entries.author: whoishiring
entries.excerpt: Please lead with the location of the position and include the keywords INTERN, REMOTE, or H1B if the corresponding sort of candidate is welcome. Feel free to post any job that may interest HN readers from executive assistant to machine learning expert to CTO. Also see: Ask HN: Freelancer? Seeking freelancer? (May 2013) https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=5637667
entries.guide_zh: 五月职位交流帖，请招聘方清楚说明工作地点与候选人条件。

entries.title: A note to myself
entries.author: clubhi

How many times do you start to work on something and never finish it? EVERY time. You've been doing this your whole life. Somehow along the way you have learned many things and even became a master in a few different areas. But that is not what you want. You want to create. It's not really creati
entries.guide_zh: 作者给自己留纸条：新点子固然诱人，把手头的事做完同样很酷。

entries.title: The new Google Hangouts will not support XMPP
entries.author: moobirubi
entries.current_title: The new Google Hangouts will not support XMPP

Google will be releasing a new communications product called Hangouts which users may choose to use instead of Google Talk. The new service does not support XMPP. As a result XMPP bots such as the App Engine XMPP service will not be able to communicate with users who adopt the new service. There are two ways to keep your App Engi
entries.guide_zh: 新 Google Hangouts 不再支持 XMPP，开发者转发相关变更通知。

entries.title: Ask HN: Google workers, sister is visiting S.J. Can she tour the Googleplex?
entries.author: fumar
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Google workers, sister is visiting S.J. Can she tour the Googleplex?
entries.excerpt: She is 21 years old and has an inoperable brain tumor. She is recovering from several surgeries. She has limited body movements, but wants to go back to school. She is unsure as to what she wants to study. I think it might inspire her to visit the campus and see people being innovative/productive in an office setting.
entries.guide_zh: 患重病的妹妹将去圣何塞，作者求谷歌员工帮助安排园区参观。

I created some projects alone, with CEO partners, CTO partners. Each time, I have no traction, negative feedback, I de
entries.guide_zh: 近三十八岁、做过多年游戏与创业后，作者在绝望中寻找下一步出路。

entries.title: Ask HN: What Freelancer site do you recommend?
entries.author: 10dpd
entries.current_title: Ask HN: What Freelancer site do you recommend?
entries.excerpt: Having unsuccessfully attempted to use Freelancer.com to complete a relatively simple job (I could do it myself but don't have time at the moment), I was wondering if HN could suggest a good freelancer sourcing site for relatively straight-forward work? Unfortunately the freelancer marketplace sites seem to be dominated by weak PHP developers.
entries.guide_zh: 一次简单外包失败后，作者征集更可靠的自由职业平台。

entries.title: Ask HN: Why can't I login to HN via Firefox?
entries.author: SeanDav
entries.current_title: Ask HN: Why can't I login to HN via Firefox?
entries.excerpt: I can login via Chrome or IE, just not Firefox. This behaviour started very recently - a matter of a few hours ago. Also, for future reference, what is the best way to ask about this sort of problem?
entries.guide_zh: Chrome 和 IE 能登录、Firefox 却不行，作者求助 HN 登录异常。

entries.title: Ask HN: Freelancer? Seeking freelancer? (May 2013)
entries.author: whoishiring
entries.excerpt: Please lead with either SEEKING WORK or SEEKING FREELANCER, your location and whether remote work is a possibility.
entries.guide_zh: 五月自由职业撮合，供求工作与找外援者介绍位置及合作方式。

entries.title: Are HN comments broken for everyone?
entries.author: rlu
entries.current_title: Are HN comments broken for everyone?
entries.excerpt: They come up as blank pages for me. I realize that if they are indeed broken for everyone that no one will be able to comment here :)
